bio.text: Dan Meuser has represented Pennsylvania's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2019 and chairs the Financial Services Subcommittee on Oversight and Investigations.
From 2011 to 2015 he was Pennsylvania's Secretary of Revenue; earlier he worked at Pride Mobility Products from 1988 and served as President of Pride USA for seven years.
He attended New York Maritime University and Cornell University, and lives in Luzerne County with his wife.
